Callout.Name: Robbery in a Small Town
Callout.Message: Hold-up at a gas station in a small town.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, cash taken, clerk unhurt.

Script.Line: He came in with a can of petrol and a lighter.
He took the cash drawer. Everybody is fine, everybody got out.
He went south on the highway in a red car.

Lines.Approach: They took the till and walked out. Clerk is shaken and the town has two roads out, so pick one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
